newsitem.title: USA: Poll shows John Warner ahead in Va. Senate race.
newsitem.headline: Poll shows John Warner ahead in Va. Senate race.

text.p: Republican John Warner holds a wide 48 to 28 percent lead over Democratic challenger Mark Warner in his bid to retain Virginia's U.S. Senate seat, a poll published Monday by the Richmond Times-Dispatch showed.
Twenty-four percent of voters surveyed in the poll, conducted Oct. 3 through 10, were undecided or favoured neither candudate, the newspaper said.

Despite the Republican's strong lead, the Times-Dispatch/12 News poll was the first published survey to put John Warner under 50 percent. It did not reflect any fallout from his campaign's use of a doctored photograph in a television ad branding the Democratic challenger a liberal who amassed his cellular communications fortune through political connections, the newspaper said.

A majority of those surveyed said they felt John Warner, a three-term senator, would do more to position Virginia's economy for the future and do a better job protecting Social Security and Medicaid. The survey was based on telephone interviews with 488 registered voters and results could vary 4.5 percentage points in either direction.
